extraction.name: OWSM v4
extraction.description: A series of fully open speech foundation models trained on 166,000 hours of cleaned speech data across 75 languages, supporting multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), any-to-English speech translation (ST), spoken language identification (LID), and voice activity detection (VAD).
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset integrates YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset with a Creative Commons license. A scalable data-cleaning pipeline was developed using public toolkits to address challenges such as incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments, yielding a curated dataset with 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset with a Creative Commons license, which had a wild nature with challenges such as incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset contains incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments due to its web-crawled nature.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Large-scale web-crawled data contains incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments that require cleaning. The raw YODAS data has substantial misalignment issues.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset covers speech across 75 languages, which includes language as a sensitive attribute.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training speech foundation models for multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), any-to-English speech translation (ST), spoken language identification (LID), and voice activity detection (VAD).
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The cleaned YODAS data, pre-trained models, data-cleaning scripts, training code, and training logs will be publicly released via the ESPnet toolkit.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: CTC-score-based filtering applied with threshold θCTC = 0.10 to remove misaligned data while retaining majority of the dataset
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Scalable data-cleaning pipeline using public toolkits to address incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments in web-crawled YODAS data, yielding 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages
